current_prompt.body:
READ the wheel graph W_11 with nodes 0 (hub) and 1-11 forming a cycle
DEFINE colors set {1,2,3,4}
COLOR each node using a color from the set such that no two adjacent nodes share the same color
OUTPUT a valid 4‑coloring assignment for all nodes
PROVE that no 3‑coloring exists by demonstrating that the odd cycle 1-2-...-11-1 together with the hub node forces a fourth color
